title: 1993 AMC 8 Problem 21
statement: If the length of a rectangle is increased by \(20\%\) and its width is increased by \(50\%,\) then the area is increased by

solutions.text:
The new length is \(1.2\) times the old and the new width is \(1.5\) times the old, so the new area is \(1.2 \times 1.5 = 1.8\) times the old area.

That is an increase of \(80\%.\)

Thus, the correct answer is D .
hints: New area \(=\) (new length) \(\times\) (new width) \(= 1.2 \times 1.5\) times the old area
Multiply the two growth factors \(1.2\) and \(1.5\) to get the factor by which the area grows
